behavior: Print a JSON array of {id,title,summary,file} for every discovered workflow app (apps/ dirs + legacy workflows/*.workflow.js), sorted by id
Case-insensitive match on app title/summary/id; human list by default, [{id,title,summary}] under --json; missing keyword throws 'Missing search keyword.'
Human card for one app (Title/Version/Summary/Author/Compatible/Inputs/Sandbox/Phases/Run line); showApp JSON under --json; missing id throws with a tip
Print a JSON array of WorkflowAppSummary (id,title,summary,version,author,file,sourceKind,legacy,compatible,inputs,sandboxProfiles,phases,taskCount)
Summary plus source, app block, and workflow block with per-task {id,kind,requiresEvidence,sandboxProfileId}; unknown id throws 'Workflow app not found: <id>'
Load by dir/app.json/entrypoint path or by id; print {valid,appId,appPath,issues[,summary]}; exit 1 when valid=false
Slugify id, write app.json+workflow.js templates to apps/<id> (or --directory/--output), refuse system dirs and existing files without --force, re-validate, print {id,manifestPath,entrypointPath}
Write {schemaVersion:1,app,workflow,packagedAt} to .cw/packages/<id>-<version>.cwapp.json (or --output); print {id,version,path}

Plan a run from app id + structured inputs (+ optional sandbox resolve); print {runId,workflowId,appId,appVersion,statePath,reportPath,pendingTasks,operatorStatus,nextActions,sandboxProfileId,sandboxProfile}
Create a run; print {runId,workflowId,statePath,reportPath,pendingTasks}; missing id throws with a tip
One command: plan(app, default architecture-review) -> run --drive -> write report; prints QuickstartResult JSON on stdout; human summary on stderr unless --json
CLI-only alias of cw quickstart (same wrapper, same payload)
A leading -q/--question redirects to quickstart and consumes the question positional so it is never read as an app id
Zero-write preflight; local checks app/repo/repo-state/question/agent(+bundle-trust-key with --bundle); prints QuickstartCheckResult; exit 1 when ok=false
Read-only deterministic DrivePreview of the next drive step (plans a fresh run if no --run); byte-stable across calls; no spawn, no commit
Advance exactly one drive step; status in-progress with hint 'one step advanced (--once) — continue: cw quickstart <app> --run <id> --once'
Without --run: advance one step and print a --resume continue line; with --run: continue that run to completion and stamp resumedFrom

Only when status=complete: seal the run via reportBundle (export + offline self-verify) into <runId>.cwrun.json at the caller's cwd; else hint '--bundle skipped: the run did not complete (status=...)'; exit 1 when bundle.ok=false
Public trust key sealed into the bundle; falls back to $CW_AGENT_ATTEST_PUBKEY; checked by the bundle-trust-key preflight
Makes the bundle-trust-key check blocked (not warn) when no trust key is configured; passed through to bundle verification

Materialize the remote (git or archive) to a local cached checkout before planning; record sourceUrl/sourceCommit[/sourceRef] as plan inputs; add 'remote' key to the payload; fail closed on bad URL/scheme/clone
--ref (alias --branch) pins the remote ref; --refresh re-fetches the cached checkout
The repo under review; -dir/--dir/-d alias --repo (explicit --repo wins); quickstart defaults to the caller's cwd when absent
Vendor shorthands mapping to --agent-command builtin:<vendor>
On a TTY with no --question, prompt 'Question: ' on stderr and use the trimmed answer; skipped when stdin is not a TTY
QUICKSTART_DEFAULT_APP = "architecture-review" when no app id is given
Unconfigured agent -> status=blocked, agentConfigured=false, completedWorkers=0, no commit, report still written; hint names CW_AGENT_COMMAND
resumedFrom/bundle/remote keys are absent (not null) on paths that did not use them, so default output stays byte-identical
Report path resolves against the run's own repo derived from statePath (three dirs up from state.json), never the caller's cwd
A --link run records a source.clone/source.download trust-audit event with url/commit/ref/kind/depth, best-effort (never fails the review)

limits default {maxAgents:20,maxConcurrentAgents:4}; inputs default []; summary default ""; throws 'workflow.id is required'/'workflow.title is required'/'workflow.phases must be an array'
phase(name,tasks,opts) -> {id:slugify(name),name,status:"pending",tasks,...opts}; throws on empty name or non-array tasks
parallel(name,tasks,opts) = phase() with mode:"parallel"; drive runs the phase's tasks as one batch up to maxConcurrentAgents; plain phase() stays sequential
loop(name,tasks,{maxRounds,until}) sets phase.loop; maxRounds must be integer>=1 (floored); until is {kind:predicate,ref} or {kind:budget-target,target>0}; throws exact messages otherwise
Make tasks of kind agent/artifact with status pending; string sandboxProfile option is accepted as sandboxProfileId; throw '<kind> task id is required' / '<kind> task <id> prompt is required'
agent-kind task with subWorkflow:{appId,inputs?,bindResult?(report|verdict-result)}; default prompt 'Delegate to sub-workflow app: <appId>'; throws when appId is empty
input(name,opts) -> {name,...opts}; throws 'input name is required'
trim -> lowercase -> non-[a-z0-9] runs to '-' -> strip edge '-' -> fold '--'+; used for phase ids and app init ids
Returns {workflow,phase,parallel,loop,agent,artifact,subWorkflow,input}; factories additionally receive defineWorkflowApp
Validates inline (appPath "inline") and returns the definition; throws WorkflowAppValidationError with .issues on failure
/^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9])?$/ else issue workflow-app-id / workflow-id 'Workflow app id is malformed: <v>'
app.schemaVersion must equal 1 else issue workflow-app-schema-version 'Workflow app schemaVersion must be 1'
version must match /^\d+\.\d+\.\d+(?:[-+][0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$/ else workflow-app-version
maxAgents/maxConcurrentAgents positive integers, maxConcurrentAgents<=maxAgents, taskCount<=maxAgents ('Workflow defines N tasks but limits.maxAgents is M')
name /^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$/ and unique; type in string|number|boolean|path|json; required/repeated boolean; codes workflow-input-*
When both exist inline, JSON.stringify equality is required else workflow-app-inputs-mismatch

References must be non-empty, unique, and bundled (default|locked-down|readonly|workspace-write); a task profile must be in the app's sandboxProfiles list when present; codes workflow-sandbox-profile*, workflow-task-sandbox-profile

Phase id /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]*$/ unique; task id /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]*$/ unique across the workflow; kind agent|artifact; prompt required; duplicate codes workflow-phase-duplicate / workflow-task-duplicate

phase.loop needs integer maxRounds>=1 and until {kind:predicate,ref}|{kind:budget-target,target>0}; codes workflow-phase-loop, workflow-phase-loop-maxrounds, workflow-phase-loop-until; predicate registration is NOT required at validate time

minVersion>current or maxVersion<current (current 0.1.98, pre-release parts cut) -> workflow-app-incompatible; workflowSchemaVersion must be 1; summary.compatible = no workflow-app-incompatible issues
workflow.entrypoint required, relative, no '..' segments; exportName must be a non-empty string when present; code workflow-app-entrypoint

Missing file -> workflow-app-manifest-not-found; bad JSON -> workflow-app-manifest-json; workflow not an entrypoint object -> workflow-app-entrypoint; entrypoint app schemaVersion/id/title/version differing from the manifest -> workflow-app-manifest-mismatch

require() the file; function export is called with {...createWorkflowApi(),defineWorkflowApp}; export must be app|workflow|factory else workflow-app-entrypoint-export; missing file -> workflow-app-entrypoint-not-found

A bare workflow export becomes an app: version 0.0.0, compatibility.maxVersion=current, notes 'Compatibility wrapper for legacy .workflow.js factory files.', metadata.legacyWorkflow=true, legacy:true in summaries
workflows/*.workflow.js + apps/*/app.json, sorted by id then source path; a duplicate app id throws 'Duplicate workflow app id <id>: <a> and <b>' and stops discovery
summary falls back app.summary->workflow.summary->""; file prefers entrypointPath->manifestPath->path; sourceKind app-directory when manifest is app.json; taskCount is the phase-task sum
A missing required input throws 'Missing required input --<name>'; missing optionals fold to default??"" so no '{{name}}' leaks into prompts
{{repo}}/{{question}} replaced; {{invariant}} and other array inputs joined with '; '; then every input key {{key}} replaced

app package output: {schemaVersion:1,app:<run metadata>,workflow:<full definition>,packagedAt:<ISO>}
Run state keeps workflowAppRunMetadata: {schemaVersion,id,title,summary,version,author,compatibility,sandboxProfiles,source,metadata}; workflow source code is NOT copied into run state
report.md carries '- Workflow App: <id>@<version>' and '- Workflow App Source: <path>'

209 static descriptors deduped by capability id (last wins); each names one shared core entry, surface both|cli-only|mcp-only, cli binding with jsonMode default|flag|human, mcp binding with tool+requiredArgs groups ('a|b' = at least one)
surface!=both or payloadIdentical:false REQUIRES a non-empty reason; reasonless exceptions are listed and block parity (fail closed)

Probe targets: 7 global + 23 run + 43 scenario; 111 deferred with one recorded reason; payloadIdenticalCapabilities defaults every both-surface dual-bound cap IN unless payloadIdentical:false AND a reason; unclassified/duplicate/invalid classifications fail the plan
Compares declared vs live MCP tools, CLI case tokens, and help tokens; ok only when every drift list, reasonless list, probe-plan list, and registry lint is empty
Duplicate capability ids, duplicate MCP tools, and surface/binding mismatches (both needs cli+mcp; cli-only forbids mcp; mcp-only forbids cli) are lint failures

Top-level command tokens plus non-subcommand aliases (audit-run stays); 'help' removed; sorted; checked against cw help output

6 tasks: Map x2 + Assess x2 (fast model hint), Verify + Verdict (strong model hint), all with label + resultCache keyed on sourceContextDigest (Assess/Verify/Verdict add includeCompletedResults:previous-phases); limits 12/4; extra inputs sourceContext/sourceContextDigest; metadata.fullReviewApp=architecture-review

8 tasks over 6 sequential phases (Inspect PR x2, Inspect CI, Diagnose(evidence), Fix Plan or Patch(workspace-write), Verify(evidence), Summary artifact(evidence)); inputs repo*,pr,branch,base,ci,mode; limits 12/4

6 tasks over 5 phases (Scope locked-down, Investigate x2 readonly, Cross-check, Verify(evidence), Synthesize artifact(evidence) locked-down); inputs question*,source[],scope,freshness; limits 12/4; works over any local corpus folder

6 tasks over 6 phases (Preflight, Version Audit, Changelog and Notes(workspace-write), Package(workspace-write), Verify(evidence), Release Verdict artifact(evidence)); inputs repo*,version*,previousVersion,releaseBranch,dryRun(boolean); limits 12/4
One phase 'Golden Path', one agent golden:path with requiresEvidence readonly; limits 1/1; input question*; the deterministic integration-proof app (npm run golden-path)

4 sequential tasks Plan(planner:plan) / Do(builder:build evidence workspace-write) / Check(auditor:audit evidence) / Act(planner:next evidence); inputs goal*,repo,acceptance; limits 4/1; version 0.1.0
3 tasks Inspect(readonly) / Implement(workspace-write) / Verify artifact(evidence readonly); input question*; limits 6/2; title 'Workflow App framework Demo'; metadata.example=true
